description: Key identifier, transaction transcript, and ML-DSA-44 signature vectors for the HCPQ v1 transaction-signature profile.
notes: Signatures are pure ML-DSA-44 (FIPS 204 ML-DSA.Sign and ML-DSA.Verify), not HashML-DSA. The message is the 32-byte transaction_digest and the context string is HCPQ-SIG-TX-v1.

Keys are derived from the listed 32-byte FIPS 204 seed. Signatures use the FIPS 204 deterministic variant (rnd is 32 zero bytes) so they are reproducible. Production signers SHOULD use the hedged variant; verification accepts both.
fips204_message is M' = 0x00 || len(context) || context || transaction_digest, the input to ML-DSA.Sign_internal, for libraries that do not accept a context string.
A test's key names an entry in key_id. When a test has its own public_key or key_id, that value replaces the key's value as a verification input.

A test is valid only if public_key is 1,312 bytes, key_id is 32 bytes and equals the identifier of public_key, signature is 2,420 bytes, and ML-DSA-44 verification succeeds over the transcript of ledger_id and body.

signed_as records how an invalid test's signature was produced (key, mode, context, message). It is always a genuine signature of that input, so each invalid test differs from a valid one in exactly the way its flag names.
transaction_digest vectors use arbitrary body bytes to test framing; signature tests use canonical TransactionBody bytes from canonical-transaction-body-vectors.json.

key_id.comment: Framing only: 1,312 zero bytes are not a valid ML-DSA-44 key.
